summary.name: Tidio
summary.one_liner: Tidio is a customer service platform combining live chat, a shared help desk inbox, and Lyro, an AI agent that resolves customer questions and drives sales, leads, and bookings.
use_cases: Resolve common customer questions automatically with an AI agent
Recover abandoned carts on an online store
Capture leads and book calls from website chat
Manage chats, emails and social messages in one shared inbox
Track sales and leads attributed to chat conversations
Recommend products to shoppers during chat
summary.what_it_does: Tidio provides website live chat and an AI agent called Lyro that answers questions using the business's own website, help center, and product data, and hands complex cases to human staff with context. Lyro can recommend products from a store catalog, recover carts, capture leads, and handle tasks like order updates through external system integrations. The platform includes a help desk with ticketing, a multichannel inbox covering live chat, email, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp, and automatic chat assignment. A drag-and-drop Flows builder offers 40+ ecommerce templates, and reports attribute sales, leads, and satisfaction to conversations. Integrations include an OpenAPI, script templates, Zapier, and 120+ apps.
notable: Lyro AI agent answers only from the business's own data and says 'I don't know' rather than guessing
Attribution reports show sales, leads and bookings per chat, channel and operator
Drag-and-drop Flows builder with 40+ ecommerce templates and no code needed
Free plan available; paid plans from $29/mo
caveats: Paid plans start at $29/mo; advanced AI Agents, priority SLAs and deep integrations are for scaled tiers
Removing Tidio branding is listed as a customization feature, implying it is not default on all plans
The 75% resolution rate and $66K+ revenue figures are vendor-reported averages/examples, not independently verified
